task_title: Correct the node-create environment contract in the runbook (CRIER_URL gate, CF-126)
task_criteria:
The correction is a docs+audit+board commit that makes docs/OPERATIONS.md and docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md true to the shipped create path, and every claim in it is executable:
(1) `grep -c 'requires `BUNKER_SERVER` in the environment' docs/OPERATIONS.md` prints 0, while the node-create entry-point bullet and the entry-point table row both name `CRIER_URL` and the gate order (`scripts/node-create.sh:69-79`) — the runbook previously named only BUNKER_SERVER.
(2) The three-arm transcript is reproducible at this commit: `env -u CRIER_URL BUNKER_SERVER=x bash scripts/node-create.sh --project p --repo https://github.com/github/gitignore --harness hermes` prints `  FAIL  crier_url — CRIER_URL unset or empty — export CRIER_URL=http://crier.example:8767` and exits 1 (the arm the new prose describes), and with `CRIER_URL` set and `BUNKER_SERVER` unset it prints `  FAIL  server_declared — ...` plus `NODE INCOMPLETE (1)`.
(3) `grep -c 'CRIER_URL=http://crier.example:8767' docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md` prints 2 (CF-101 and CF-110 recipes now carry the value the create path refuses without).
(4) `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS (rc 0) and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK at the committed tree.
(5) Board row CF-165 exists in the committed tree with status pending and a non-empty `probe`; `docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04-create-env.md` records the before/after table with file:line, the code path, the literal arm output and the "not measured" list.
The docs change itself is the deliverable; no code change is expected or required by this task.
